name: study-flow-assistant
description: Comprehensive academic study assistant: customizable Pomodoro timer, task and habit tracker, time blocking calendar, metrics, and distraction-free Zen mode.

scripts.deploy: node -e 'const dest = process.env.OBSIDIAN_VAULT_PATH; if (!dest) { console.error("Set OBSIDIAN_VAULT_PATH"); process.exit(1); } const fs = require("fs"); const p = dest + "/.obsidian/plugins/study-flow-assistant"; fs.mkdirSync(p, { recursive: true }); ["main.js", "manifest.json", "styles.css"].forEach(f => fs.copyFileSync(f, p + "/" + f)); console.log("Deployed to " + p);'

author: dalt
